title: Leveraging LLMs as Meta-Judges: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating LLM Judgments

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the precision of LLM meta-judgments against objective ground-truth labels from the JudgeBench dataset (covering knowledge, reasoning, math, and coding) to filter out inaccurate, inconsistent, or biased model evaluations using a multi-agent collaborative framework and structured rubrics.
